posts.text: At Fort Snelling National Cemetery today I visited my dad’s gravesite. He was proud to be a veteran, and now rests among the “heroes among us” he so often wrote about — the brave men and women who served our country with courage and humility.

I spoke at the Memorial Day Ceremony at Fort Snelling National Cemetery to honor heroes like Nicole Amor of White Bear Lake, who died serving in Kuwait this year, and Captain Bianchi of New Ulm, who gave his life in World War II.

Their courage helped secure the freedoms we enjoy today.

On Memorial Day, we honor the brave men and women who made the ultimate sacrifice for our country and remember the families who carry their legacy forward. That includes Joey Amor and the Amor kids & family. Nicole Amor of White Bear Lake died this year in Kuwait, bravely serving our nation. 

Our soldiers’ sacrifice can never be forgotten.

May is Pool Safety Month, a time to raise awareness about drowning prevention and keeping kids safe.  I’ve worked to strengthen pool safety protections so families can enjoy Minnesota summers safely.🌊⛱️
Stopped by the Copper Pony in Sauk Rapids for some coffee and cookies on this beautiful Sunday. Great to meet their staff!

In Little Falls today for the Minnesota State Memorial Day Cemetery to honor the fallen men and women who gave everything for our country. Their sacrifice can never be forgotten, and we carry a duty to those who laid down their lives so we could live ours.

Thank you to the Northern Midwest Regional Council of Carpenters for their endorsement. I grew up in a union family and I believe in the strength of Minnesota’s workforce — and as Governor, I will make sure that hard work is respected and rewarded.

Honored to earn the endorsement of Education Minnesota. My mom taught 2nd grade until she was 70, and education made my family’s story possible.

I will work to strengthen our schools and focus on success for our students, parents, educators and state.

Minnesota is home to many incredible restaurants. Great to see National Geographic name Minneapolis one of the top 15 global destinations for food.

While costs are through the roof, what has the president been focused on?

-Fighting a war costing taxpayers billions of dollars.

-Building a billion-dollar ballroom and an arch dedicated to himself.

Not lowering your costs.

Trump’s war with Iran has cost Americans more than $42 billion in gas and diesel costs. That’s more than $300 per family. Not peanuts.


Aaron Rupar (@atrupar)

Trump on high gas prices: "This is peanuts. I appreciate everybody putting up with it for a little while. But I don't even think about. What I think about is you can't let Iran have a nuclear weapon."

They’re blocking a vote that would’ve reined in the President’s unauthorized war with Iran.

Congress needs to do its job and assert its constitutional authority to end this war that has already cost Americans more than $42 billion in higher fuel costs.

In 2024, 564 Minnesotans lost their lives to gun violence.

And last year, two little kids’ lives were taken in the Annunciation shooting months after Melissa and Mark Hortman were killed in their own home.

We need action on common-sense gun legislation. I will always fight to keep Minnesotans safe.

A good way to end the night and begin the day. And they had us at “hello!” Thanks for a great run Stephen Colbert!


Spencer Althouse (@SpencerAlthouse)

this was so sweet. Stephen Colbert just ended his final episode of The Late Show while singing "Hello, Goodbye" with Paul McCartney. his family and the show's crew then joined them on stage before Paul turned off the lights to the Ed Sullivan Theater
